meta.title: Togakushi Ski Resort
meta.description: ~42 min by car from Nagano Station — magical powder snow and the spiritual mystery of Togakushi Shrine.

transit.title:
42 minutes
from Nagano Station.
transit.lead: Pick up a rental car at Nagano Station and drive ~42 minutes to base elevation 1,220 m — "magical powder snow" and Togakushi ridge panoramas. Pair with the Hokuriku Shinkansen for a realistic weekend powder trip.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy drive from Nagano toward Togakushi — Shinshu mountain scenery

primary.title: Magical powder & Champion run
primary.lead: Dry powder at 1,220 m base and the 31° groomed burn on Champion Course. Less crowding than Hakuba mega-resorts — premium snow and carving for advanced skiers.
primary.imgAlt: Skier in light powder on Togakushi Champion course — mountain panorama

secondary.title: After skiing, soba & shrines
secondary.lead: From queue-famous soba at Uzuraya to cedar avenues at Togakushi Shrine — ski and cultural history in one day loop, unique to Nagano's doorstep.

onsen.title:
Kamikokage onsen &
Togakushi baths
onsen.lead: From Yugokan at the Chusha base to Mure Onsen Tengu-no-Yakata and Susobana Ururuikan — post-ski recovery is easy to plan across the area.
onsen.whisper: On shrine pilgrimage peak days, allow extra time for evening baths.
onsen.imgAlt: Steam from snow-view outdoor bath — Togakushi area onsen

yugokan.title: Togakushi Kamikokage Onsen Yugokan
yugokan.lead: 3182 Togakushi, Nagano. Day-use bath at the Chusha base — convenient right after skiing. TEL 026-254-1126 (verify).
yugokan.imgAlt: Yugokan outdoor bath — Kamikokage Onsen at Togakushi

tengu.title: Mure Onsen Tengu-no-Yakata
tengu.lead: 2755-345 Kawakami, Iizuna, Nagano. ~30 min by car from Togakushi — forest hot spring with day use (verify). TEL 026-253-3740.
tengu.imgAlt: Tengu-no-Yakata — forest hot spring in Mure

urumoi.title: Susobana Ururuikan
urumoi.lead: 98 Tsumashina, Nagano. Natural hot spring on the return to Nagano city — final recovery before car return. TEL 026-237-4126.
urumoi.imgAlt: Ururuikan indoor bath — Susobana natural hot spring

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning: rental from Nagano Station → afternoon: Champion powder → Uzuraya soba → evening: Yugokan bath → next morning: Togakushi Shrine visit.

uzuraya.title: Uzuraya
uzuraya.lead: 3229 Togakushi, Nagano. Hand-ground stone-mill soba — expect lines even in winter. TEL 026-254-2219.
uzuraya.imgAlt: Uzuraya Togakushi soba — famous stone-mill shop

sobanomi.title: Sobanomi
sobanomi.lead: 3510-25 Togakushi, Nagano. A longtime Togakushi soba shop — warm pure buckwheat noodles. TEL 026-254-2102.
sobanomi.imgAlt: Sobanomi hand-cut soba — classic Togakushi shop

powder.title: Magical powder & Champion
powder.body: Dry powder at 1,220 m base and Champion Course to 31°. 19 runs, 3,000 m max length — a skilled local resort for advanced skiers avoiding mega-resort crowds.

nagano.title: ~42 min from Nagano Station
nagano.body: ~42 min by car from Nagano Station (Zenkoji exit bus area). Pair JR Nagano with a rental car for wider loops to Togakushi Shrine, Shiga Kogen, and Hakuba. Route bus ~60–80 min (Alpico — verify).

shrine.title: Ninja slope & Togakushi Shrine
shrine.body: Ninja Slope with a moving walkway is popular for families. After skiing, cedar avenues at Togakushi Shrine and famous soba shops — sport and cultural history in one day.
